tools.name: get_book_contents
tools.description: The contents of «From Voltage to Prompt. How Machines Learned to Make Music» by Mike Fluff: its sections and parts (slug, title, whether it is free to read), the price, and the URL of each part. Free parts read whole with read_part; the rest after the person buys the book (buy_book).

tools.name: read_part
tools.description: The whole text of one part of the book, in the language asked (or Russian, the original, where a translation is missing). Free parts read for anyone; other parts for a person signed in with "nobodyquits:purchase" who owns the book.

tools.name: buy_book
tools.description: For the person signed in with INITE ID ("nobodyquits:purchase"): a payment link for the whole book. The person pays on that page themselves (card or PIX) and every part opens for their account; nothing is charged by this call. Says so if they already own it. tools.name: get_author_inbox
tools.description: For the author only: the notes readers sent them and the comments that are hidden (held by moderation, or hidden by hand), newest first, each with a link to its place. Publish or hide with moderate_comment. Needs the author signed in with the nobodyquits:author scope. Read-only.

tools.name: moderate_comment
tools.description: SIDE EFFECT: for the author only. `publish` shows a hidden or held comment to every reader of the chapter; `hide` takes one down (it stays visible to the author). Ids come from get_author_inbox or get_chapter_discussion. Needs the author signed in with the nobodyquits:author scope.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_book_contents, get_chapter_discussion, post_comment, send_note_to_author, get_author_inbox · Private data: get_chapter_discussion, post_comment, send_note_to_author · Public sink: get_chapter_discussion, post_comment, send_note_to_author, get_author_inbox, moderate_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_book_contents, get_chapter_discussion, post_comment, send_note_to_author, get_author_inbox · Private data: get_chapter_discussion, post_comment, send_note_to_author · Public sink: get_chapter_discussion, post_comment, send_note_to_author, get_author_inbox, moderate_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
